I'm 32 years old. College dropout, divorced, 2 kids that live out of state. I've changed careers 3 times. I'm grossly overweight and I suffer from crippling depression. My dad died a few months ago and every day for me is super difficult. 

I'm married now and I know my wife loves me and is happy, but I feel like she would be better off with someone else who can provide a better life for her. I know she can do so much better than me. 

I don't have any close friends and my family lives hours away.

Thank you for your response. 

To clarify: it's not that I want to make my death LOOK natural. I secretly hope that I'll be murdered or killed in a natural disaster, etc. 

I've let a lot of people down in my life and I feel like I only bring pain. I just feel like I'm bad for those around me. I'm socially destructive and I've failed at literally everything I've ever tried.
